Microsoft Edge WebView2 Evergreen Runtime — separate third-party terms
For the Windows x64 Clash Verge Rev v2.5.2 offline companion package.
Checked 2026-09-19.

PACKAGE AND OFFLINE INSTALLATION
The selected application is the unchanged regular upstream installer:
Clash.Verge_2.5.2_x64-setup.exe
A separate official Microsoft link provides the unchanged Evergreen Standalone
Runtime installer, version 153.0.4234.48, acquired directly from Microsoft:
MicrosoftEdgeWebView2RuntimeInstallerX64.exe
The companion link is provided only as the runtime prerequisite for this application,
not as an independent stand-alone software offering. If WebView2 is missing,
install the Microsoft-downloaded companion FIRST, then install Clash Verge. The full
standalone runtime installer supports offline installation; the application's
small embedded bootstrapper alone does not replace it on a disconnected system.
A sufficiently current preinstalled WebView2 runtime can be reused.

Microsoft and its suppliers retain their rights. WebView2 is NOT relicensed
under the GUI's GNU GPL. Neither installer is modified, and this repository is
not affiliated with or endorsed by Microsoft. Preserve the runtime files,
Microsoft/supplier notices, applicable terms and third-party notices.

OFFLINE LICENSE COPIES
- LICENSE.WebView2.html.txt preserves the complete evergreenHtml value returned
  by Microsoft's official license endpoint, encoded as UTF-8 without edits.
- LICENSE.WebView2.txt contains the same full license text, with HTML markup
  removed and line whitespace normalized for local reading; no clauses omitted.
The upstream endpoint contains replacement characters in some punctuation and
French text; the verbatim HTML-value copy retains them rather than inventing
corrected license text. Both files were obtained on 2026-09-19.

Read the full applicable Microsoft terms before installing or using the runtime.
This notice does not accept an agreement on anyone's behalf or assert that any
recipient has already accepted it. The supplied terms and applicable agreement,
not this summary or the repository's license, control runtime use/distribution.

REQUIRED NOTICE TO END USERS
This application package includes Microsoft Edge WebView2 and Microsoft Defender
SmartScreen. SmartScreen is enabled by default in the runtime. Unless disabled
by the application, it collects and sends end-user information to Microsoft as
described in Microsoft's Privacy Statement and Microsoft Edge Privacy Whitepaper:
https://aka.ms/privacy
https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/microsoft-edge/privacy-whitepaper#smartscreen
WebView2 may also collect usage information as described in its terms and those
privacy references. This package does not claim to disable those features.
The Evergreen runtime may periodically check for, download and install updates
when connectivity is available. Offline installation does not mean the software
never accesses the network. Windows 7/8.1 are not supported by this app/runtime
selection; the complete license's historical update disclosure is retained.
